purpose: Confirm a substantial rescue with another independent training seed rather than selecting one favorable test run
norman_trigger: An expanded-feature or balanced-training model reaches interaction residual R2 >= 0.3 on the same source203 target genes using all control cells
ipsc_trigger: An endpoint-only extension recovers at least half of the observed day1 T excess, improves mean MSE >=10%, and retains a genuine day1 peak under matched endpoint/middle sampling
if_triggered: Train at least one additional independent seed with exactly the same chosen training configuration; retain all results
if_not_triggered: Finish all pre-specified data, numerical, inference, training and positive controls; do not run an unbounded test-tuned search
scope: Operational confirmation rule for this local investigation, not a universal definition of biological accuracy
